reason: Adapter-based cross-lingual ASR fine-tuning is not LLM inference. Primary abstract: Cross-lingual speech adaptation aims to solve the problem of leveraging multiple rich-resource languages to build models for a low-resource target language. Since the low-resource language has limited training data, speech recognition models can easily overfit. Adapter is a versatile module that can be plugged into Transformer for parameter-efficient learning. In this paper, we propose to use adapters for parameter-efficient cross-lingual speech adaptation.
